text:
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: infra/runner@2026.03.21-rc5 -> prod (canary). Change window: now. Automated checks passed (smoke, lint). Rollback tag: v1.4.3-hotfix. Approvals required: 2. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollouts/2026-03-21-rc5
anna: approve — checksum ok, I verified artifact SHA256.
mike: quick q — does this touch kv-cache hot path? last deploy there caused 5xx spikes.
sylvie: yes, touches kv-cache TTL handling. Plan: disable prefix caching via FF, canary at 5% for 10m, monitor p95 latency and error-rate. If p95 > 250ms or errors > 0.5% revert.
dave: approve from infra. Confirmed no DB schema change. If we hit errors we have rollback script ready: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runner --to-revision=stable`
ops-lead: hold — need release notes link and customer-facing blurb before full rollout. Add brief to RN and tag cc-sales. Once RN updated I can +1.
anna: added RN stub: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-rc5 (one-liner + impact). ops-lead please check.
ops-lead: ack, updating. After RN I can approve.
sylvie: telemetry hooks in place (latency, token-success, kv-hits). I also added a short circuit to disable new path: `ENABLE_KV_V2=false` in prod if needed.
sre-bot: automated canary check ready. Will post status every 2m. Thresholds: p95 latency 250ms, errors 0.5%, token failure 0.2%.
deploy-bot: Awaiting 2 human approvals. To approve reply 'approve' or react :thumbsup:. To start manual rollout: `/deploy start infra/runner@2026.03.21-rc5 --canary 5% --window 10m`
anna: approve
dave: approve
sre-bot: canary monitor: baseline p95 180ms, errors 0.06% (pre-deploy).
ops-lead: approved after RN update. go ahead when canary green.
deploy-bot: Starting canary: 5% -> 50% -> 100%, step duration 10m. Notifying on #incidents if thresholds breached.
sylvie: running smoke probe: `curl -sS https://prod.health/runner/health | jq .status` -> "ok"
anna: thumbs on logs: `2026-03-21T15:02:12Z runner: canary init, kv enabled=false, snapshot=s2026-03-21-rc5`
sre-bot: canary 5% 2m: p95 185ms, errors 0.09% — within thresholds.
mike: thanks — keeping an eye on kv hit-rate. If kv-hit drops >30% revert.
sre-bot: canary 10m: p95 190ms, errors 0.07%, kv-hit stable. Proceeding to 50%.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 50%. Next check in 10m.
sylvie: monitoring dashboards, no spikes.
ops-lead: marking release notes final. Good to proceed to full.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100%.
sre-bot: full rollout 5m: p95 195ms, errors 0.08%. All clear.
anna: great job team. Closing thread and filing rollback snapshot metadata.
ops-lead: filing post-deploy checklist and tagging CS. :white_check_mark:
